senses.gloss: m. (v. קוּן; cmp. תובל קין Gen. IV, 22) artist, esp. metal-worker, silversmith.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 10:9">Targ. Jer. X, 9</cite> (h. text <cite ref="R00260"><he>צורף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 66:10">Targ. Ps. LXVI, 10</cite> <he>קינאה</he> (ed. Wil. <he>קֵנָ׳</he>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 17:4">Targ. Jud. XVII, 4</cite>; a. fr.—Y. B. Bath. II, beg. 13ᵇ <he>אין הוה כגון ק׳ וכ׳</he> if a workshop has been there before, e. g. that of a silversmith or a smith &c.—Pl. <he>קֵינָאֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Targ. Esth. V, 14</cite> <he>ית נגרייא וית ק׳</he> the carpenters and the forgers of arms.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Ib.</cite> <he>קַיְינָאֵי דמתקנין וכ׳</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>קייצ׳</he>, corr. acc.) the smiths, that they may make a knife.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Ib.</cite> <he>ולקיינ׳</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>ולקיצ׳</he>, corr. acc.). Targ. II Esth. I, 2 <he>וכל קינאי</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <cite ref="S01579"><he>קניגייא</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
